cover:fact_opinion.p: A small fluffy ginger kitten detective in a tiny deerstalker hat measuring a cake with a ruler while a raccoon dreamily hugs an eclair, bakery counter

fact_opinion:0.p: A kitten detective carefully counting a neat box of colorful pastries with a tape measure and a magnifying glass, focused and precise

fact_opinion:1.p: A raccoon with heart eyes holding an eclair while a hedgehog beside him dreamily hugs a strawberry tart, each with a dreamy thought cloud

fact_opinion:2.p: A kitten detective sorting candies into two baskets, one with a magnifying glass charm and one with a heart-shaped thought cloud charm

fact_opinion:3.p: A cute penguin flapping its wings hard on an icy cliff edge but staying on the ground, a kitten detective checking with a book, comic surprise

fact_opinion:4.p: A raccoon with crumbs on his face next to three empty pie plates, a squirrel frowning disapprovingly, a kitten detective taking notes

fact_opinion:5.p: A kitten detective pointing at tiny paw-print crumbs leading to a sleepy hedgehog, puzzle pieces clicking together above its head

cover:cause_effect.p: A small fluffy ginger kitten detective in a tiny deerstalker hat watching a row of candy dominoes topple one after another, amazed

cause_effect:0.p: An ice cream cone melting into a puddle under the bright sun on a park bench, a surprised kitten detective nearby

cause_effect:1.p: A hedgehog in a blue cap shrugging innocently next to an empty pie dish, a kitten detective scratching its head thoughtfully

cause_effect:2.p: A squirrel proudly wearing bright green socks and holding a lottery ticket shaped like a leaf, dice tumbling around, playful scene

cause_effect:3.p: A blazing cheerful sun shining over a beach where animals eat ice cream and wear sun hats, the sun connecting both with golden rays

cause_effect:4.p: A flat sad cake on a kitchen table with an empty sugar bowl, a clock showing the wrong moment and a cold oven, a raccoon baker sighing

cause_effect:5.p: Rain falling on a forest path, a raccoon slipping on the wet path and a cake flying out of his paws in a funny chain of events

cover:evidence.p: A small fluffy ginger kitten detective in a tiny deerstalker hat following a trail of paw prints and crumbs across a kitchen floor with a magnifying glass

evidence:0.p: Close-up of muddy paw prints and cake crumbs on a white tablecloth, a kitten detective's magnifying glass hovering over them

evidence:1.p: A magpie whispering to a sparrow who whispers to a rabbit in a long gossip chain, while an owl who actually saw the event stands apart calmly

evidence:2.p: Three different animal witnesses, a mouse, a rabbit and a duck, all pointing in the same direction, a kitten detective nodding

evidence:3.p: A raccoon with jam on his paws insisting innocence with crossed fingers behind his back, a kitten detective raising one eyebrow

evidence:4.p: A kitten detective in a tiny lab coat comparing clues with a big encyclopedia and a test tube, a library background

evidence:5.p: A balance scale with a unique patterned paw print on one side outweighing a single fluffy hair on the other, kitten detective observing

cover:traps.p: A small fluffy ginger kitten detective in a tiny deerstalker hat carefully stepping around tricky cartoon traps made of tangled thought threads in a maze

traps:0.p: A flock of sheep all grabbing candy from a jar while one clever kitten detective stands apart with paws crossed, shaking its head

traps:1.p: A grumpy fox pointing at a raccoon who is kindly helping an old turtle carry groceries, proving the fox wrong

traps:2.p: A fox showing only two doors while a kitten detective discovers a whole hallway of many other colorful doors behind him

traps:3.p: A small squirrel sharing a pie equally with a knife while a tall fox points at her size instead of the pie, kitten detective unimpressed

traps:4.p: A pompous bear wearing a crown on a tiny throne declaring something loudly, a kitten detective calmly asking with a raised paw

traps:5.p: A raccoon pointing sideways toward a messy hedgehog room to distract, while a kitten detective keeps looking at the empty pie plate

cover:ads.p: A small fluffy ginger kitten detective in a tiny deerstalker hat examining a giant shiny lemonade bottle on a billboard with a magnifying glass

ads:0.p: A colorful shop window full of glittering candy boxes with sparkles and stars, a kitten detective holding a small shopping basket and thinking

ads:1.p: A lemonade bottle standing on a podium with a gold trophy and fireworks, a kitten detective tasting it and looking unconvinced

ads:2.p: A frantic cartoon hourglass running with sand pouring out over a sale table, animals rushing, a calm kitten detective walking away

ads:3.p: A famous athlete rabbit posing with a soda can for a photographer, a kitten detective noticing a bag of coins handed to him

ads:4.p: A kitten detective lying on the floor with a big magnifying glass inspecting the tiny bottom corner of a huge poster, curious

ads:5.p: A pretty gift box opening to reveal a hidden price tag shaped like a coin on a string, a kitten detective peeking inside suspiciously

cover:news_fakes.p: A small fluffy ginger kitten detective in a tiny deerstalker hat pulling a smiling mask off a newspaper monster, revealing a little sheepish mouse

news_fakes:0.p: A cute paper newspaper character wearing a theater mask, sneaking among real newspapers, a kitten detective spotting it

news_fakes:1.p: A kitten detective with three floating question mark bubbles holding a newspaper, one bubble with a person silhouette, one a clock, one a target

news_fakes:2.p: A loud megaphone shouting with exaggerated lightning and exclamation-shaped sparks at frightened candies, a calm kitten detective covering its ears

news_fakes:3.p: A kitten detective comparing an old faded flood photo with a calendar and a sunny window showing dry streets today

news_fakes:4.p: A friendly robot painting a picture of a cat astronaut and a penguin in a desert, a kitten detective counting the cat's extra fingers

news_fakes:5.p: An anime girl pausing before pressing send on a phone, checking several stacked books and newspapers first, thoughtful expression

cover:logic.p: A small fluffy ginger kitten detective in a tiny deerstalker hat walking across a bridge made of linked puzzle pieces between two candy islands

logic:0.p: Rain clouds pouring over a street making the asphalt shiny and wet, while nearby a street sweeper sprays water on a dry road, kitten detective watching

logic:1.p: A kitten detective pointing at a perfectly dry sunny sidewalk with no puddles, a closed umbrella hanging on its arm

logic:2.p: A group of many cats of different colors all eating fish happily, with just a couple of ginger ones highlighted by a soft spotlight

logic:3.p: Three puzzle pieces fitting together: a crowd of purring cats, a ginger kitten detective, and the kitten detective purring happily

logic:4.p: A kitten detective shrugging between a jar of lollipops and a big birthday cake, a question cloud floating above

logic:5.p: A hedgehog, a fox and a raccoon standing on steps of a staircase from shortest to tallest, a kitten detective drawing them in a notebook

cover:patterns.p: A small fluffy ginger kitten detective in a tiny deerstalker hat studying a long repeating row of candies and chocolates, one odd carrot hiding among them

patterns:0.p: An apple, a pear and a plum sitting happily together while a carrot stands out awkwardly, a kitten detective pointing at the carrot

patterns:1.p: A kitten detective explaining to friends, gesturing at four objects on a table: a red ball, a red apple, a blue ball and a green pear

patterns:2.p: Stacks of macarons growing taller step by step in a neat row on a bakery shelf, a kitten detective guessing the next stack

patterns:3.p: A staircase of cookie towers where each step grows by one more cookie than the last, a kitten detective measuring the gaps

patterns:4.p: A long candy necklace with a repeating pattern of two lollipops and one chocolate bar, a kitten detective holding the next piece

patterns:5.p: A kitten detective hiding behind a curtain at night next to a pastry display, waiting patiently to catch a sneaky mouse thief

cover:cases.p: A small fluffy ginger kitten detective in a tiny deerstalker hat at a desk with a corkboard of suspect animal portraits connected by red string

cases:0.p: A kitten detective with scissors cutting away paper suspect portraits one by one, leaving a single surprised raccoon portrait

cases:1.p: A hedgehog happily playing violin in a music class far away while a kitten detective in the foreground looks at an empty pie plate

cases:2.p: A kitten detective drawing a grid on a big sheet with little animal faces in rows and tiny check marks and crosses, cozy office

cases:3.p: Three animal suspects standing in a row, one fox with a slightly growing long nose, kitten detective thinking with chin on paw

cases:4.p: A fox walking innocently past a cake, a kitten detective holding back its first guess and calmly collecting clues with a slow turtle beside it

cover:kind_debate.p: A small fluffy ginger kitten detective in a tiny deerstalker hat sitting at a tea table debating kindly with a squirrel, a white dove resting between them

kind_debate:2.p: A kitten detective leaning forward with a curious friendly face asking a raccoon, a glowing question mark-shaped lantern between them

kind_debate:3.p: A kitten detective with big attentive ears listening fully to a squirrel explaining, both sitting cross-legged on a rug

kind_debate:4.p: A kitten detective looking at a new clue and smiling with a little turning arrow of light, shaking paws with a friend

kind_debate:5.p: A squirrel with vanilla ice cream and a raccoon with chocolate ice cream clinking cones together and laughing
